source: Derived from CheatSheetApp/Sources/{AppDesign,AppTheme,ViewModifiers}.swift and Shared/Sources/CheatSheetNote.swift — verified against actual constants, not estimated.

brandPrimary.name: CheatSheet Blue
brandPrimary.evidence: AccentColor.colorset sRGB (0.294, 0.533, 1.000) == CheatSheetPalette.blue ("4B88FF") exactly. This is the true brand primary, not a guess.

colorMode: Full light/dark support, branches explicitly on colorScheme (AppTheme.swift). No forced single mode.

windowBackdrop.evidence: AppTheme.windowGradient(for:) exact RGB values, linear gradient topLeading->bottomTrailing

materialTreatment.primary: Native Liquid Glass (.glassEffect / .buttonStyle(.glass...) / GlassEffectContainer) on macOS 26+ / iOS 26+
materialTreatment.noteContentSurface: .regularMaterial base + palette-tint overlay at 9-16% opacity + 1px hairline stroke at 8-14% opacity

typography.uiChrome: System semantic text styles throughout (.title, .callout, .caption, .headline) — Dynamic Type respected, no custom typeface

iconLanguage.system: SF Symbols exclusively, no custom iconography

motionPersonality: Restrained — a single .snappy(duration: 0.22) selection animation on the palette swatch; no bouncy/playful motion anywhere in the codebase.
emotionalTone: Calm, precise, get-in-get-out utility. Product principles explicitly state 'deliberately narrow.' No celebratory confetti, no gamification, no streaks/badges.
doNotIntroduce: Unrelated neon/purple-blue generic AI-gradient backdrops not derived from AppTheme's actual gradient stops
Stock photography or hands-on-devices imagery — nothing like that exists in the app or its current marketing
Playful/bouncy motion or confetti — contradicts the app's own restrained animation choices
Any claim of cloud sync, collaboration, or accounts — none exist
